verdict.rationale: Algolia's Rules apply conditional changes to search results, such as repositioning products or running temporary seasonal promotions. Its ingestion layer also manages schedules, retries, and transformations from the dashboard without deploying code. Together these give limited condition-to-action automation scoped to search queries and data syncs, not general event-driven rules. Missing for 10: general event triggers (webhooks or event subscriptions), user-defined actions beyond result manipulation, documented condition/consequence rule semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
